annotations.title: Who in my Circle is already going

description: Trips people in the connected person's Circle already plan today or tomorrow that fit an errand: a store run someone's item could ride along on, a return or post office stop, a trip they both make. Returns the person's first name, the trip label, an approximate time only if they share times, the kind of store, and which of the connected person's items could ride along. Never a location. Use for 'is anyone passing a pharmacy today', 'who could grab the milk', 'anyone going to Target'. Asking the person happens in the CitySignal app. Needs a connected account with Circle access.

category.description: A store kind or word: pharmacy, grocery, Target, post office.
